purpose: TRACK0-06 My Itinerary / completed state rendering rules

{{DESTINATION}}.when_missing: remove destination text component; retain DAYS if available

{{DAYS}}.format: display-ready text, e.g. 5 天 4 夜
{{DAYS}}.when_missing: remove days text component; retain DESTINATION if available

when_missing.hero: retain hero image but remove hero.action
when_missing.cta_if_no_dashboard_fallback: remove footer CTA and log data error

tag_policy.normalization: take first two non-empty tags and compact them into TAG_1/TAG_2
tag_policy.two_tags: render separator + tag row with two pills
tag_policy.one_tag: render separator + tag row with one pill
tag_policy.zero_tags: remove both separator and tag row

product_boundary: Current itinerary selection logic is owned by product/backend; this template only renders the selected completed itinerary.
